pages.library: Computer Vision Toolbox Interface for OpenCV in Simulink

fm.title: Opencv interface
fm.description: Data conversion blocks for interfacing Simulink with OpenCV C++ code (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Convert a Simulink image signal into a MATLAB matrix format — use to prepare image data from Simulink sources for processing by OpenCV-based C++ code
Convert a MATLAB matrix back into a Simulink image signal — use to return processed results from OpenCV-based code back into the Simulink image pipeline
Convert an OpenCV cv::Mat data structure into Simulink signal format — use at the output boundary of custom OpenCV C++ S-Functions to pass results back to Simulink
Convert a Simulink signal into an OpenCV cv::Mat data structure — use at the input boundary of custom OpenCV C++ S-Functions to pass image data into OpenCV algorithms
